name: Energy
definition: Power, land, and cooling for data centers.
note: The deck calls power the "ultimate moat". Contracts are now priced in gigawatts, not GPUs.

name: Chips (compute)
note: A physical bottleneck with about 75% gross margin during the build-out. TPUs and custom chips spread it out later.

name: Infrastructure (AI factory)
definition: Clouds, data centers, and developer tools that turn chips into usable AI.
note: Infra players keep 10% at most (AWS is the exception at 35%). Neoclouds that borrow to buy GPUs are a spread business.

name: Models
definition: Companies that train large AI models others build on.
note: Followers trail the frontier by about 4 months, and by about 6 weeks in coding. The price of the same capability falls about 10x a year.

name: Applications
definition: Products people and businesses use, including robots doing physical work.
note: Closest to the person paying. Wins if it owns the customer or the reward signal from a real operation.
